ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (22) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 7 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

«Труд» (trud, 'labor') and «трудиться» (trudit'sya, 'to labor') keep the one English root throughout. In [7] «метающий» (metayushchiy) is read as «мешающий» (meshayushchiy, 'hindering'), and in [21] the evident «не только не облегчающая» ('not only not lightening') is translated; both are flagged. The website had no draft for [7].

Source observation: [7] «метающий другим» (metayushchiy drugim, 'sweeping/throwing to others') is evidently a slip for «мешающий другим» (meshayushchiy drugim, 'hindering others'); translated 'hindering others.'

Source observation: [21] «не только облегчающая труд других, но накладывающая на них новые труды» ('not only lightening the labor of others but laying new labors on them') contradicts itself; a «не» ('not') has evidently dropped out before «облегчающая»; translated 'not only does not lighten.'
